spaces.label: Forge
spaces.description: A coding space assembled from marketplace parts: this plugin's layout, rail-t3 in the rail, mochi-mark as the badge, thread-minimal and composer-minimal as the session surface's two sections, and env-minimal pinned top-right. TWO pieces are NOT from the marketplace, stated rather than hidden: the workspace host filling forge-main (no contributed workspace component exists), and the dock COLUMN (dock-classic) — session-board is a dock TAB, i.e. the instrument role, so it appears inside that dock rather than replacing it. Those two gaps are the measurement this space exists to take.
